run.command: yardr peer intake beta --depot web --flow main
run.description: Say where the beads a peer sends go: the depot and the flow
does: the link with beta (it calls itself yard, key dgAPuSi-…) takes its beads for the depot web as beads of this yard there, pinned to the flow main and labelled from-beta: at most 10 of them are open at once.
Its beads arrive in the stage backlog, which no route leads anywhere from: they wait until one does (yardr route add --stage backlog --group <group> --label from-beta).
A bead of it that names no remote goes to this intake.
It has no intake for the depot web now.
